title: Grade 1 Social Studies — Being a Helpful Member of a Group
subject: Social Studies
description: Practice with questions on respect, fairness, participation, responsibility.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: Which action helps a new student join a group game?
choices: invite them and explain the rules

questions.question: Two people want different books for story time. What can the group do fairly?
choices: take a vote after hearing both choices

questions.question: What does following through on a promise show?
What should you do before using a friend's crayons?
When someone has an idea you disagree with, what can you do?
choices: listen and explain your idea kindly

questions.question: Which action helps care for a shared park?
choices: leave food wrappers on a bench

questions.question: A classmate needs help finding the office. What is helpful?
choices: tell them to take your seat
point out the way or ask a teacher

questions.question: Why might a group vote?
choices: to hide what choices it has
to erase a rule without talking

questions.question: A game was set up with space for only fast runners. What can make it more open?
choices: change the rules so more people can join
let the fastest pick all the teams
make the field smaller without asking

questions.question: What is one example of respectful listening?
choices: turn up music while they talk
talk to someone else at the same time
let a speaker finish before you speak

questions.question: Which action is an example of volunteering?
choices: choosing to help sort donated books
being paid to fix a sink on a work shift

questions.question: Why should everyone have a chance to share an idea?
choices: Different ideas can help the group choose.
Plans work best if no one asks questions.
Only the last speaker can be right.
Strong voices always have the best idea.

questions.question: Who can care for a library by returning borrowed books on time?
A playground has an empty water bottle on the path. What helps others?
choices: put it in the correct bin or tell an adult
open it and pour it on the ground

questions.question: Two students disagree about a shared toy. What can they do first?
Which is a responsibility when you use a shared tablet?
choices: handle it carefully and return it

questions.question: A class chooses a name for its reading corner. What is fair before the vote?
choices: count one person's vote many times
share the choices with the whole class

questions.question: What can you do if you see someone being left out again and again?
choices: tell more people to leave them out
invite them and tell a trusted adult if help is needed

questions.question: What means treating someone with respect?
choices: speak kindly and take their ideas seriously

questions.question: How can families help a neighborhood event?
choices: choose a job to help with
move the event without telling anybody
